lines.text: Anything not fully specified gets /agentic-engineering:but-first-planning grill (one question at a time, each with a recommendation) before it is planned or handed to an unwatched session.

A plan lives in .agents/plan/, or in .agents/plans/<name>/ for one feature or task: a spec decision changes through /agentic-engineering:but-first-planning spec-edit, and an issue is built from its acceptance criteria as failing tests first (/agentic-engineering:but-first-planning build-tdd).
A published plan is worked through /agentic-engineering:agent-works orchestrate: its issues are cards on the board.
